title: What To Do If There's a Risk of Lightning
question: If you think there is a risk of lightning nearby while you are playing, what should you do according to the Rules of Golf?

choices.text: Keep playing until the Committee officially suspends play
Wait for your friends to decide
Stop playing immediately for your own safety
Only stop playing if it starts to rain

explanation: If you believe there is a danger from lightning, you should stop play at once, even if the Committee has not yet officially suspended play.
